source.title: Utah FORGE April 2024 microseismic event catalog

scope: CNN trained only on controlled synthetic Gaussian clouds; real FORGE records are qualitative out-of-domain event-envelope demonstrations.

model.name: 32×32 event-density CNN → Gaussian ellipse geometry
model.coordinateConvention: Input row index increases with normalized y; x is column. Domain [-1,1]^2. Axes are Gaussian 1-sigma scales; multiply by sqrt(-2*ln(1-coverage)) for a 2D Gaussian coverage ellipse. Angle=.5*atan2(output[5],output[4]); normalize angle vector only for display.
